terminal_rule: Q_STOP=0; Q_SUBMIT_0=1-2*sigmoid(logit); Q_SUBMIT_1=2*sigmoid(logit)-1. WAIT/READ/REPAIR retain learned continuation scores.
training: Initialize each head from its old frozen fit; freeze its entire finite cell/export tables. Four rounds collect actual fixed/value mixed policy visits with epsilon=.2 from the same new TRAIN worlds. Accumulate sampled realized-cell rows and train the head for 60 AdamW updates each round (240 additional updates total); targets are TRAIN-fitted Bayes posterior/DP and never policy inputs. No checkpoint selection; final update always exported. Validation is diagnostic only.
inference: Same realized cell transition table and pre-action driver as baseline; actual file opens/FullHX calls through Python Owner. Repaired fixed/value share weights. Separate native qualification does not turn Python confirmation into Rust runs.
statistics: Five paired fit means; Student t df=4, two-sided Bonferroni intervals across 14 primary contrast/split pairs; familywise alpha=.05. Benefit requires adjusted lower bound > .02 utility, and an IID-and-OOD claim requires both splits. Secondary terminal-only and old/new contrasts remain descriptive.
costs: Record actual CPU/wall, actual content calls, model/table bytes, new training + collection costs; old training remains sunk prerequisite cost. No energy or speedup claim. Training and inference use numpy with one BLAS thread; this is head repair, not all-parameter cell training.
freeze: Publish this protocol and source before fitting, and all 25 final artifacts with hashes before generating new confirmation worlds. Retain failed attempts; no confirmation tuning.
failure_rule: No seed or failed run may be removed. Fixes require a new recorded source identity and whole affected-stage rerun; failed output stays retained.
